name: week
title: Fulfilment week
subtitle: Today's pick wave, what is waiting for the courier, and despatch against the agreed days

sections.title: Pick wave
sections.note: Open orders, ready to pick first, then by required date.
sections.sql: select client, number, required_by, lines, items, has_dg, sla, pick_check from order_view where status = 'open' order by (pick_check = 'Ready to pick') desc, required_by, client, number

sections.title: Picked, waiting for the courier
sections.sql: select client, number, required_by, items, has_dg, sla from order_view where status = 'picked' order by required_by

sections.title: Despatch against agreed days, last 28 days
sections.sql: select client, despatch_days, despatched_28d, on_time_28d, late_28d, on_time_pct, late_now from sla_view order by client

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.note: Late and blocked orders, stock to reorder, inbound overdue, returns waiting and missing rates.
sections.sql: select issue, reference, client, detail from attention_view order by issue, client, reference

sections.title: Record checks
sections.note: Retention of recipient details and billing records, and dangerous goods services. See docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, reference, client, finding from compliance_view order by rule, reference

sections.title: Below reorder point
sections.sql: select client, sku, product, on_hand, allocated, available, reorder_point from product_stock_view where active and reorder_point > 0 and available <= reorder_point order by available

sections.title: All SKUs
sections.sql: select client, sku, product, on_hand, allocated, available, bins from product_stock_view where active order by client, sku

sections.title: Storage this week
sections.sql: select client, currency, bins, bin_week_cents, amount_cents from storage_view order by client

sections.title: Billing runs
sections.sql: select r.name, r.period_from, r.period_to, r.status, r.approved_by, c.name as client, l.currency, l.kind, l.units, l.rate_cents, l.amount_cents from charge_lines l join charge_runs r on r.id = l.run_id join clients c on c.id = l.client_id order by r.period_to desc, c.name, l.kind
